components.html:
Zaak data via ZAC_zaak_gegevens

Every row shows one property of the zaak: on the left the path as written in ZAC_VELD, next to it the value. For dates and booleans the value is shown twice: first as the zaak holds it, then with a ZAC_FORMAAT function wrapped around it. Lists are joined with a comma; use [] to read on into a property of every element, as in kenmerken[].kenmerk. A dash means the property holds no value — the API omits empty properties, so a misspelled property cannot be told apart from an empty one. The last panel holds six deliberate mistakes, which are detectable.
